description: This file defines a class 'DatabaseSelectingPersistenceUnitPostProcessor' that implements 'PersistenceUnitPostProcessor'. Its purpose is to set the target database property for a persistence unit based on the resolved database type, primarily configuring JPA persistence units for different database types (MySQL, PostgreSQL).

classes.name: DatabaseSelectingPersistenceUnitPostProcessor
classes.description: Implements a post-processor that configures the persistence unit with the appropriate target database based on the current database type.

methods.name: postProcessPersistenceUnitInfo
methods.description: Sets the target database property in the persistence unit info based on the resolved database type.
